reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The Project involves the provision of a follow-on senior secured loan of up to EUR 10 million to Global Export Company LLC, increasing the total EBRD exposure to up to EUR 15 million. The Project supports the Borrower's continued capital investment in processing facilities and equipment, including expansion into mung beans, dried apricots and raisins, as well as permanent working capital needs to support scaling export operations. The Project remains 100% GET eligible, derived from investment in energy-efficient equipment and promotion of low-GHG agricultural value chains.
